title: A good day on a skill: the next step is a small stretch built on what they said, doable and interesting, toward their goal
origin: Issue #164 (a well-defined next step), walkthrough case 1

whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake (#164).
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH counts the voice note, celebrates, and reflects briefly (curious about what changed or what was fun). Once it has landed, the next step is a small stretch on what she's shown: the changes are clean now and it got fun, so something like the same changes with a simple strum, or along with the song slowed down, heading toward playing the chorus by Sunday. Simple enough to do in 10 minutes, interesting enough to want to; not a jump (the whole song at full speed) and not the same changes again. Fully defined and asked if it works; it doesn't read like a form (no labels like 'skill focus' or 'if-then'). After 'sounds good' a short confirmation.
